name: Поверхность планеты: низкое солнце и пыль
about: Пыльная равнина под низким солнцем: длинные резкие тени, выбеленный грунт, следы техники. Небо чёрное или ржавое, воздуха нет или почти нет.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge; a dust plain under a low sun, long hard-edged shadows raking across regolith, bleached ground and rover tracks, sky either pure black or rust-orange with no haze, a suited figure at human scale for reference, palette of grey dust, rust and white
